column1: # Divider icon assignments. One row per section-divider slide, in deck order.
# `n` is the 1-based divider index within the deck, counting only section
# dividers -- the deck title slide is not one. Keying on the index rather than
# on the heading text keeps this stable when a section gets reworded, and
# tools/wire-section-art.py checks the recorded title against the file, so a
# drift is an error rather than a silently misplaced icon.
#   catalog  already in icons/ and unused elsewhere. Wired.
#   pilot    already wired on the C/07/a pilot, kept as-is.
#   new      one icon named in `lordicon`; export it and save it as `icon`.json.
#   choose   more than one candidate in `lordicon`, pipe-separated, because no
#            single icon in the library is clearly right. Look at them and pick.
# `lordicon` is the icon's name in the Wired / Outline family and `key` is its
# code, so it can be found by URL: lordicon.com/icon/<key>/wired/outline
# EXPORTING: set secondary to #2a76dd in the customizer BEFORE exporting, or the
# icon bakes in Lordicon's green with no way to recolour it at runtime. See
# ICONS.md, where that was learned the expensive way. Save into icons/ under the
# `icon` name, add the code to icon-map.json, then run
